Santa Clara records 2 scam reports for week ending July 11, 2026
J. B. Padron
During the week ending July 11, 2026, Santa Clara had two scam reports, according to Better Business Bureau.
There were no scam reports listed for the city in the previous week.
One report that listed a dollar amount accounted for $49.95 in reported losses. The most common scam type was counterfeit product, which accounted for one of the reports.
BBB Scam Tracker lets consumers search reported scams and share their experiences to help others recognize similar schemes. The BBB says it reviews each report before publication and does not publicly display the reporter’s name or personal contact information.
Fraud reports have continued to show large financial losses nationwide. The Federal Trade Commission said consumers reported losing more than $12.5 billion to fraud in 2024, a 25% increase from the previous year.
| Date | Scam type | Reported loss |
|---|---|---|
| July 7 | Employment | No reported loss |
| July 6 | Counterfeit Product | $49.95 |
